description.html: This low oval dish has an orange-red terracotta color and a porous stone texture with small pits on the outer sides. The inside is wide and shallow, and on one side the bottom rises gently toward the rim, forming a natural slope.

The slope is the most useful detail of this dish. Hatchlings, small geckos and tiny lizards can walk into the water gradually and get out easily, without climbing over a high edge. The slope also helps insects that accidentally fall in to crawl out, so they are less likely to drown and foul the water.
The warm orange color fits desert terrariums with reddish sand and clay, as well as setups with bark and dry leaves.

Position the dish with the slope facing the side your animal usually approaches from. Fill it about halfway, change the water every day and wash the dish with warm water without harsh cleaning products.
